'''2007 Worlds Team Nate Albright DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nate Albright]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team Days Inn. Struck lines; First Strike/Presence fill for 60. 10 shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Nate Albright]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out From The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
